subject: Recap + scheduling: demo & dedicated capacity sizing
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@matrixpayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: Recap + scheduling: demo & dedicated capacity sizing

Hi Alicia — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Primary workload: real-time transaction enrichment + fraud scoring (~1k qps peak per region, 50-200 tokens per request).
- SLOs: 95th perc latency target ~200ms for the online path; batch embedding jobs off-peak.
- Data requirements: no PCI data will be sent; tokens may include account metadata, PII redaction required.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Schedule a dedicated capacity sizing session (technical deep dive) with our SRE/Serving team to lock a reserved pool and confirm latency targets.
2) Follow up with a short capacity intake (traffic profile + sample payloads) before that call — helps us pick the right pool/quantization profile.
3) Run a quick demo of the streaming API and KV-cache behaviour during the technical deep dive.

Proposed time windows (all ET):
- Thursday 12/17 11:00–12:00
- Friday 12/18 09:30–10:30

If neither works, send a couple of slots that work for your engineering lead and procurement contact and we’ll prioritize. I’ve attached a simple workload snapshot template to speed the intake.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: matrix_workload_snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@matrixpayments.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Matrix Payments Procurement <procurement@matrixpayments.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + scheduling: demo & dedicated capacity sizing

Thanks Vivek — great summary. I’ve looped in our lead infra engineer, Tomas (tomas@matrixpayments.com), and procurement on this thread. Quick responses to your bullets: 

- The qps and token range you noted look right for our peak. I attached a short snapshot with our recent peak window.
- We do need PII handling guidance; we can redact on our side but would like to review redaction recommendations during the call.
- Procurement would like a rough cost band (monthly) for a dedicated pool before kickoff — ballpark is fine so we can budget.

Availability for a call: Thursday 12/17 11:00 ET works for Tomas and me. Please confirm and include dial-in + any prep docs.

Appreciate it,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Platform Engineering | Matrix Payments
alicia.ramos@matrixpayments.com
Attachment: matrix_workload_snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@matrixpayments.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + scheduling: demo & dedicated capacity sizing

On Tue, Dec 15, 2026 at 4:05 PM Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@matrixpayments.com> wrote:
> Availability for a call: Thursday 12/17 11:00 ET works for Tomas and me. Please confirm and include dial-in + any prep docs.

Perfect — locking Thursday 12/17 11:00–12:00 ET. I’ll bring our serving lead (infra@redwood.com) and the runtime engineer who owns KV-cache/caching strategies. 

Prep pack (attached): redwood_capacity_intake.pdf — please fill the shaded sections with your traffic distribution and a sanitized sample payload. That helps our runtime team select a kernel/quant profile and pre-provision a pool size.

Dial-in + meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/meet/vivek-matrix-20261217 (will send calendar invite in a moment).

Agenda (30 min technical deep dive, 20 min demo + Q&A, 10 min procurement & next steps):
- Quick intro & goals (5min)
- Workload profile review (10min)
- Latency/throughput modeling & recommended pool sizing (15min)
- Live demo: streaming + KV-cache warmup behavior (20min)
- Procurement checklist & next milestones (10min)

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_capacity_intake.pdf (pdf)
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@matrixpayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + scheduling: demo & dedicated capacity sizing

Thanks Marissa — confirmed for Thu 12/17 at 11:00 ET. I've forwarded the intake PDF to Tomas and procurement; they’ll fill and return by EOD tomorrow. Two quick asks for the kickoff: 
1) Can you include a short SOC2 evidence checklist for our security team to review pre-call?
2) We’re primarily interested in a US-west placement for latency; can you note if there are price differences for region-specific dedicated pools?

If you can put a ballpark monthly range in the kickoff slide (range is fine), procurement is comfortable progressing to NDA and a mutual action plan.

See you on Thursday.

Alicia
